content:
Two architectures for enterprise commerce. Salesforce and VTEX, side by side.

In this issue

  • Two Buildings On The Same Block. An enterprise commerce buyer in 2026 walks into the conference room with two RFP responses on the table.
  • The Fortress. Salesforce Commerce Cloud. Salesforce as a company was founded in 1999. The CRM is 27 years old.
  • The Skyscraper. VTEX. VTEX is what VTEX built starting in Brazil in 2000 and rebuilt around its IO Platform over the last decade.
  • The Foundation. Operational Infrastructure. The first dimension that separates the fortress and the skyscraper is what the building rests on.
  • Structural Load. Logistics and OMS. Salesforce Order Management is a credible product.
  • The Lobby. Customer Experience. Checkout and personalization is the dimension where the fortress's CRM lineage is hardest to dismiss.
  • The Marketplace Floor. VTEX ships a native multi-seller marketplace engine.
